title: Trading trained docked at Node Alpha: weapon housings bought at its ask and sold back into its bid at the same station, no jump
note: 2026-11-22 15:41 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-064, block MERCURY (every trader operating at the least fuel per XP, before jump loops) and rule F23 (a trader with no class work open trains trading). Trading is the class skill and lags (guidebook trade card: 2 on 29 ships); it rises about 1 XP per 100 cr bought and as much per 100 cr sold (levelling guide). Node Alpha's book (table books, read 2026-11-22 15:40 UTC): weapon_housing bid 223 x 46, ask 230 x 174, a spread of 3%: a round trip of 10 units costs about 70 cr for about 45 Trading XP, docked, no fuel, against train-jumps-trader at -551 cr a ship-hour.
